verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows web search and agentic search that can 'follow links autonomously'. That is web retrieval, not control of a real browser: nothing documents logging in, clicking or interacting with live pages. Tool servers and MCP integration are developer building blocks that could be used to construct such a capability, but they are not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant can drive a real browser — navigate, log in, click, and extract from live pages on my behalf
